title: The Monsoon House
summary: Rain on the tiled roof of the Iyer ancestral home; the courtyard breathes. No dialogue.

title: Car Banter
summary: Car ride; siblings banter over the sale.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Six months to sell, Meera. That's what the papers say.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: The papers don't remember who fed us here.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: The papers don't have to.

title: Welcome at the Gate
summary: The siblings arrive; Suresh greets them at his shop.

lines.speaker: c5
lines.text: Mungaru, aagi! Aana, aana.
lines.translation: Welcome home! Come in, come in.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: We grew up crossing this road, Anand.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: I grew up running from it.

title: The Dusty Hall
summary: The dusty ancestral hall, old photographs on the wall.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: Mother kept every photo on this wall.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: I didn't know we kept so many.

title: The Argument
summary: Siblings argue at the table over selling the house.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: My firm's dues are due in four months. Sentiment won't pay them.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: You always wanted this house sold.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: I wanted us to survive.

title: Lakshmi's Arrival
summary: Lakshmi arrives with the evening meal; old habits, old tension.

lines.speaker: c3
lines.text: Thirty years I cooked in this kitchen. You two are late.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Sorry, Amma. I mean, Lakshmi.

title: Dinner Table
summary: Dinner; Lakshmi's cooking; old habits survive.

lines.speaker: c3
lines.text: Kannu chusi, kaasu kaanu.
lines.translation: Close your eyes and taste the food.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: She's been saying that since we could walk.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: And we've been closing our eyes since.

title: Power Cut
summary: Power cut; the old house creaks; Meera is frightened.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: Did you hear that?

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Old house. It's just the wind.

title: The Hidden Ledger
summary: A second back to the cupboard; a ledger from 1998.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: This cupboard has a second back.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: A ledger, in Mother's handwriting. 1998.

title: The Shop Confrontation
summary: Meera confronts Suresh at his shop; he flares.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: You've been watching this house for thirty years, Suresh.

lines.speaker: c5
lines.text: I watched my shop burn the year your father sold my land!

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: Your father never sold my land.

title: Ravi Returns
summary: Ravi appears at the gate after ten years.

lines.speaker: c4
lines.text: You sent me away. I came back anyway.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Ten years, Ravi. Ten years.

lines.speaker: c4
lines.text: Time doesn't keep your hours, Anand.

title: Veranda Talk
summary: Meera and Ravi talk on the veranda; he speaks in Kannada.

lines.speaker: c4
lines.text: Ninnu noddala. Nee anna one, naanu noddala.
lines.translation: I won't leave you. Your brother is my blood brother — I won't leave you.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: Nobody's promised us anything about this house.

title: The Locked Room
summary: The sealed granary room, a new lock.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: The granary was sealed. With a new lock.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Who seals a room in a house no one lives in?

title: To Open or Not
summary: The siblings decide whether to open the granary.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: Whatever's in there, we open it together.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Together. Fine. But I'm breaking the lock.

title: Village Feast
summary: The village feast; half the town shows up.

lines.speaker: c6
lines.text: Aaga kodiya, kanna! Vaa, vaa!
lines.translation: The chicken's ready, child! Come, come!

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: Half the village is here. The other half brought food.

title: Mother's Kitchen
summary: Meera alone in her mother's kitchen.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: You made my first dosa here. You never left the stove, did you?

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: I'm sorry I wasn't here, Amma.

title: The Old Letters
summary: Anand reads the mother's old letters.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Every letter ends with the same line.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: When the monsoon ends, you will know why I stayed.

title: Ravi's Warning
summary: Ravi tells Anand he knows something; Anand pushes back.

lines.speaker: c4
lines.text: You didn't send me away because I was a friend.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Then why did you come back?

title: The Letter
summary: The mother's letter is read aloud; the land was signed away.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: My dearest children — I have signed away the land.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: This house was never legally ours. And that was my love.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: Mother sold our house? When?

spoiler_note: PROTECTED: P1 revealed in this scene at 09:38.000

title: Meera's Anger
summary: Meera's anger at her mother, after the letter.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: She sold it and wrote us a poem about it.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: I don't know my mother. I didn't.

title: The Key Line
summary: Close-up of the letter's key line; the date on the deed.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: The debt was mine to carry, not yours.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: The deed was signed in 1998. Before I was born.

spoiler_note: PROTECTED: continues P1 reveal; top historic performer (see historic_performance.json)

title: Suresh's Truth
summary: Suresh reveals the original deed; he was mother's ally.

lines.speaker: c5
lines.text: I kept the original deed for thirty years.

lines.speaker: c5
lines.text: Your mother asked me to. I was never your enemy.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: Then why let us think you were?

spoiler_note: PROTECTED: P2 revealed in this scene at 11:20.000

title: The Decision
summary: The siblings decide to keep the house.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: We keep the house. Not for the papers. For the wall of photos.

lines.speaker: c2
lines.text: Together. Like the old photos say.

title: The Gathering
summary: Neighbors and family gather to help.

lines.speaker: c4
lines.text: I said I'd come back. I didn't say I'd leave again.

lines.speaker: c3
lines.text: Aana, aana. Kaana naa.

title: Dawn After Rain
summary: Dawn after rain over the house. No dialogue in frame; a closing voice-over.

lines.speaker: c1
lines.text: Some houses don't keep you. You keep them.
